<title level="1" pfs="">[Majungasaurus](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3262)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

The majungasaurus prowls in a crouched posture, carrying its bulk so low to the ground it is eye-to-eye with its prey. Unlike most carnivorous dinosaurs, the majungasaurus is primarily an ambush predator, patiently lying in wait for quarry to come within reach before bursting from cover with a signature cry to attack.

<column gap="tiny">
**[Recall Knowledge - Animal](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**
([Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=43)): DC 22

**[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 20

**[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 17
</column>

</column>

<column gap="medium">

</column>

</row>

<title level="2" right="Creature 6">[Majungasaurus](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3262)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Huge" />
<trait label="Animal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=531" />
<trait label="Dinosaur" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=576" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 137

**Perception** +12; [low-light vision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=69), [scent](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=74) ([imprecise](/Rules.aspx?ID=412)) 30 feet

**Languages**

**Skills**
[Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=34) +15, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) +16, [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=40) +14, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=48) +16

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +6

**Dex** +5

**Con** +4

**Int** -4

**Wis** +2

**Cha** +4
</row>

**Startling Roar** When the majungasaurus rolls initiative using [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=48), it can attempt to [Demoralize](/Actions.aspx?ID=2395) each creature within 30 feet as a free action. Regardless of the effect, each creature is then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 23 

**Fort** +14 

**Ref** +17 

**Will** +12 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 120

</row>

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 25 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
jaws +16 ([reach 15 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)),
**Damage** 2d8+6 piercing plus [Grab](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=45)

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
foot +16 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170)),
**Damage** 2d6+6 bludgeoning

**Crack Bones** <actions string="Single Action" />  **Requirements** The majungasaurus has a creature [grabbed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=77) in its jaws; **Effect** The majungasaurus deals that creature 3d8 bludgeoning damage (DC 24 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Fortitude save). A creature that fails this save is [clumsy 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=61) until it recovers to full Hit Points.

**Frightened Prey**   [Frightened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=76) creatures are [off-guard](/Conditions.aspx?ID=58) to a majungasaurus.

</column>
